greek: προσκαλεσάμενος δὲ Ισαακ τὸν Ιακωβ εὐλόγησεν αὐτὸν καὶ ἐνετείλατο αὐτῷ λέγων Οὐ λήμψῃ γυναῖκα ἐκ τῶν θυγατέρων Χανααν·
hint: Isaac blesses Jacob and charges him not to take a wife from the daughters of Canaan.

notes.text: The middle of προσκαλέω, *to call to oneself*.
Capitalised because it opens direct speech, as Rahlfs prints it; listed in `speech` so the checks do not take it for a proper name.

reading: [[having called to himself|having called to himself, having called to one, having called to his aid, having cited|προσκαλέω]] [[but|but, however, whereas, on the other hand|δέ]], [[name:Ισαακ]] the [[name:Ιακωβ]] [[spoke well of|spoke well of, praised, honoured, blessed|εὐλογέω]] him and [[enjoined|enjoined, commanded|ἐντέλλομαι]] to him [[saying|saying, speaking, declaring, calling by name, telling|λέγω]] not [[you will take|you will take, you will receive, you will take hold of and grasp and seize|λαμβάνω]] [[woman|woman, mistress and lady, wife and spouse, mortal woman|γυνή]] [[out of|out of, forth from, from|ἐκ]] of the daughters of [[name:Χανααν]];

names.gloss: (Ιακωβ, from Hebrew Yaʿăqōb, which the Hebrew of 25:26 hears in ʿāqēb, "heel")
(Χανααν, from Hebrew Kĕnaʿan, of uncertain meaning)

greek: ἀναστὰς ἀπόδραθι εἰς τὴν Μεσοποταμίαν εἰς τὸν οἶκον Βαθουηλ τοῦ πατρὸς τῆς μητρός σου καὶ λαβὲ σεαυτῷ ἐκεῖθεν γυναῖκα ἐκ τῶν θυγατέρων Λαβαν τοῦ ἀδελφοῦ τῆς μητρός σου.
hint: Jacob is to go off to Mesopotamia, to Bethuel's house, and take a wife from Laban's daughters.

notes.text: [[flag]] The Hebrew is *paddenâ ʾărām*, *to Paddan-aram*, as at 25:20.
[[flag]] Codex Alexandrinus adds Συρίας; the Berlin papyrus, 911, does not.

reading: [[having stood up|having stood up, having risen, having risen to fight against, having risen to go and set out|ἀνίστημι]] [[run away|run away and off and escape, flee from, desert, flee and shun|ἀποδιδράσκω]] [[into|into, to, in, rest in|εἰς]] the [[name:Μεσοποταμίαν]] [[into|into, to, in, rest in|εἰς]] [[the house|the house and abode and dwelling, the room and chamber, the house of a god and temple, the household goods and substance, the household and family|οἶκος]] of [[name:Βαθουηλ]] [[of the father|of the father, of the grandfather|πατήρ]] [[of the mother|of the mother, of the dam, of the source|μήτηρ]] of you and [[take|take, receive, take hold of and grasp and seize|λαμβάνω]] for yourself [[from that place|from that place and thence, thereafter and next|ἐκεῖθεν]] [[woman|woman, mistress and lady, wife and spouse, mortal woman|γυνή]] [[out of|out of, forth from, from|ἐκ]] of the daughters of [[name:Λαβαν]] [[of the son of the same mother|of the son of the same mother, of the brother, of the near kinsman|ἀδελφός]] [[of the mother|of the mother, of the dam, of the source|μήτηρ]] of you.

names.gloss: (Μεσοποταμία, Greek, "the land between the rivers", for Hebrew Paddan-ʾĂrām)
(Βαθουηλ, from Hebrew Bĕtûʾēl, of uncertain meaning)

greek: ὁ δὲ θεός μου εὐλογήσαι σε καὶ αὐξήσαι σε καὶ πληθύναι σε, καὶ ἔσῃ εἰς συναγωγὰς ἐθνῶν·
hint: Isaac prays that God bless Jacob, increase him, and make him gatherings of nations.

notes.text: Three aorist optatives, the wish, as δῴη at 27:28.
συναγωγή is first *a bringing together, uniting*.

reading: [[but|but, however, whereas, on the other hand|δέ]], [[the God|him who is God definitively, the one the article marks out, the known and the only|θεός]] of me [[may he speak well of|may he speak well of, may he praise, may he honour, may he bless|εὐλογέω]] you and [[may he make large|may he make large and increase and augment, may he increase in power and strengthen and exalt and aggrandise, may he promote to honour and glorify and magnify, may he grow and wax and increase, may he grow up|αὐξάνω]] you and [[may he make full|may he make full and increase and multiply|πληθύνω]] you, and you will be [[into|into, to, in, rest in|εἰς]] [[bringings together|bringings together and unitings, places of assembly and synagogues, drawings together and contractings|συναγωγή]] [[of numbers of people accustomed to live together|of numbers of people accustomed to live together and companies and bodies of men, of hosts, of swarms and flocks, of nations and peoples, of nations and gentiles, of special classes, of castes and tribes, of sexes|ἔθνος]];

greek: καὶ δῴη σοι τὴν εὐλογίαν Αβρααμ τοῦ πατρός μου, σοὶ καὶ τῷ σπέρματί σου μετὰ σέ, κληρονομῆσαι τὴν γῆν τῆς παροικήσεώς σου, ἣν ἔδωκεν ὁ θεὸς τῷ Αβρααμ.
hint: Isaac prays that Jacob receive Abraham's blessing and inherit the land of his sojourning.

notes.text: παροίκησις, one sense, *a neighbourhood*, of the land where one dwells beside.
[[flag]] Codex Alexandrinus alone reads δέδωκεν, the perfect.

reading: and [[may he give|may he give, may he grant, may he provide, may he give over and deliver up|δίδωμι]] to you [[the good language|the good language, the fine language, the fair speech and specious talk, the eulogy and panegyric, the blessing|εὐλογία]] of [[name:Αβρααμ]] [[of the father|of the father, of the grandfather|πατήρ]] of me, to you and [[to the that which is sown|to the that which is sown, to the seed, to the germ and origin and element, to the offspring and issue, to the race and descent|σπέρμα]] of you [[into the middle of|into the middle of, coming among, in pursuit and quest of, after|μετά + accusative]] you, [[to receive a share of an inheritance|to receive a share of an inheritance and inherit a portion, to inherit, to be an inheritor, to succeed|κληρονομέω]] [[the earth|the earth, the land, the ground|γῆ]] of the neighbourhood of you, which [[gave|gave, granted, provided, gave over and delivered up|δίδωμι]] [[the God|him who is God definitively, the one the article marks out, the known and the only|θεός]] to the [[name:Αβρααμ]].

names.gloss: (Αβρααμ, from Hebrew ʾAbrāhām, which the Hebrew of 17:5 hears in ʾab hămôn gôyim, "father of a multitude of nations")

greek: καὶ ἀπέστειλεν Ισαακ τὸν Ιακωβ, καὶ ἐπορεύθη εἰς τὴν Μεσοποταμίαν πρὸς Λαβαν τὸν υἱὸν Βαθουηλ τοῦ Σύρου ἀδελφὸν δὲ Ρεβεκκας τῆς μητρὸς Ιακωβ καὶ Ησαυ.
hint: Isaac sends Jacob off to Mesopotamia, to Laban son of Bethuel the Syrian, Rebekah's brother.

notes.text: δέ inside the phrase, as often: *and the brother of Rebekah*.

reading: and [[sent off|sent off, sent away and banished, despatched, went away and departed|ἀποστέλλω]] [[name:Ισαακ]] the [[name:Ιακωβ]], and [[was driven|was driven, was carried, went, walked, marched, went across and passed|πορεύομαι]] [[into|into, to, in, rest in|εἰς]] the [[name:Μεσοποταμίαν]] [[toward|toward, facing, oriented to, in living motion and address toward|πρός + accusative]] [[name:Λαβαν]] the son of [[name:Βαθουηλ]] of the [[name:Σύρου]] [[son of the same mother|a son of the same mother, a brother, a near kinsman|ἀδελφός]] [[but|but, however, whereas, on the other hand|δέ]], of [[name:Ρεβεκκας]] [[of the mother|of the mother, of the dam, of the source|μήτηρ]] of [[name:Ιακωβ]] and of [[name:Ησαυ]].

names.gloss: (Σύρος, the man of Συρία, Syria; the Hebrew has ʾărammî, the Aramean)
(Ρεβεκκα, from Hebrew Ribqâ, of uncertain meaning)
(Ησαυ, from Hebrew ʿĒśāw, usually connected with śēʿār, "hair")

greek: Εἶδεν δὲ Ησαυ ὅτι εὐλόγησεν Ισαακ τὸν Ιακωβ καὶ ἀπῴχετο εἰς τὴν Μεσοποταμίαν Συρίας λαβεῖν ἑαυτῷ ἐκεῖθεν γυναῖκα ἐν τῷ εὐλογεῖν αὐτὸν καὶ ἐνετείλατο αὐτῷ λέγων Οὐ λήμψῃ γυναῖκα ἀπὸ τῶν θυγατέρων Χανααν,
hint: Esau learns of Jacob's blessing, his journey to Mesopotamia, and the charge not to marry a daughter of Canaan.

notes.text: ἐν with the articular infinitive, `in the speaking well of`, as at 24:52.
[[flag]] Codex Alexandrinus alone leaves it out.
Capitalised because it opens direct speech, as Rahlfs prints it; listed in `speech` so the checks do not take it for a proper name.

reading: [[saw|saw, perceived, beheld, looked at|ὁράω]] [[but|but, however, whereas, on the other hand|δέ]], [[name:Ησαυ]] [[that|that, seeing that, although, for that, because, inasmuch as|ὅτι]] [[spoke well of|spoke well of, praised, honoured, blessed|εὐλογέω]] [[name:Ισαακ]] the [[name:Ιακωβ]] and [[was being gone away|was being gone away and far from, was being gone and had departed and was being absent, was being gone and had perished, was being dead and gone|ἀποίχομαι]] [[into|into, to, in, rest in|εἰς]] the [[name:Μεσοποταμίαν]] of [[name:Συρίας]] [[to take|to take, to receive, to take hold of and grasp and seize|λαμβάνω]] for himself [[from that place|from that place and thence, thereafter and next|ἐκεῖθεν]] [[woman|woman, mistress and lady, wife and spouse, mortal woman|γυνή]] [[in the speaking well of|within, inside of, and by means of the speaking well of, the praising, the honouring, the blessing|ἐν; εὐλογέω]] him and [[enjoined|enjoined, commanded|ἐντέλλομαι]] to him [[saying|saying, speaking, declaring, calling by name, telling|λέγω]] not [[you will take|you will take, you will receive, you will take hold of and grasp and seize|λαμβάνω]] [[woman|woman, mistress and lady, wife and spouse, mortal woman|γυνή]] [[from|from, away from, far from, apart from|ἀπό]] of the daughters of [[name:Χανααν]],

names.gloss: (Συρία, the Greek name of the land; the Hebrew here is Paddan-ʾĂrām)

greek: καὶ ἤκουσεν Ιακωβ τοῦ πατρὸς καὶ τῆς μητρὸς αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐπορεύθη εἰς τὴν Μεσοποταμίαν Συρίας,
hint: Jacob obeys his father and mother and goes to Mesopotamia of Syria.

notes.text: [[flag]] The Berlin papyrus, 911, has it; Codex Alexandrinus leaves it out.

reading: and [[heard|heard, had hearing of, heard tell of, knew by hearsay, hearkened and gave ear, listened to and obeyed|ἀκούω]] [[name:Ιακωβ]] [[of the father|of the father, of the grandfather|πατήρ]] and [[of the mother|of the mother, of the dam, of the source|μήτηρ]] of him and [[was driven|was driven, was carried, went, walked, marched, went across and passed|πορεύομαι]] [[into|into, to, in, rest in|εἰς]] the [[name:Μεσοποταμίαν]] of [[name:Συρίας]],

greek: καὶ εἶδεν Ησαυ ὅτι πονηραί εἰσιν αἱ θυγατέρες Χανααν ἐναντίον Ισαακ τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτοῦ,
hint: Esau sees that the daughters of Canaan are evil before Isaac.

notes.text: πονηρός, the chain of GEN 2:9: *toilsome, painful, grievous* before *wicked*.

reading: and [[saw|saw, perceived, beheld, looked at|ὁράω]] [[name:Ησαυ]] [[that|that, seeing that, although, for that, because, inasmuch as|ὅτι]] [[toilsome|toilsome and painful and grievous, good-for-nothing, bad and worthless, wicked|πονηρός]] are the daughters of [[name:Χανααν]] [[in the presence of|in the presence of and before, opposite and face to face, against|ἐναντίον]] of [[name:Ισαακ]] [[of the father|of the father, of the grandfather|πατήρ]] of him,

greek: καὶ ἐπορεύθη Ησαυ πρὸς Ισμαηλ καὶ ἔλαβεν τὴν Μαελεθ θυγατέρα Ισμαηλ τοῦ υἱοῦ Αβρααμ ἀδελφὴν Ναβαιωθ πρὸς ταῖς γυναιξὶν αὐτοῦ γυναῖκα.
hint: Esau goes to Ishmael and takes Mahalath, Ishmael's daughter, as a wife besides his others.

notes.text: πρός with the dative, *beside*, of what is added.

reading: and [[was driven|was driven, was carried, went, walked, marched, went across and passed|πορεύομαι]] [[name:Ησαυ]] [[toward|toward, facing, oriented to, in living motion and address toward|πρός + accusative]] [[name:Ισμαηλ]] and [[took|took, received, took hold of and grasped and seized|λαμβάνω]] the [[name:Μαελεθ]] daughter of [[name:Ισμαηλ]] the son of [[name:Αβρααμ]] sister of [[name:Ναβαιωθ]] [[toward|toward, facing, oriented to, in living motion and address toward|πρός + accusative]] [[to the women|to the women, to the mistresses and ladies, to the wives and spouses, to the mortal women|γυνή]] of him [[woman|woman, mistress and lady, wife and spouse, mortal woman|γυνή]].

names.gloss: (Μαελεθ, from Hebrew Māḥălat, of uncertain meaning)
(Ναβαιωθ, from Hebrew Nĕbāyôt, of uncertain meaning)

greek: Καὶ ἐξῆλθεν Ιακωβ ἀπὸ τοῦ φρέατος τοῦ ὅρκου καὶ ἐπορεύθη εἰς Χαρραν.
hint: Jacob leaves the Well of the Oath for Haran.

notes.text: The place named at 26:33, Beersheba.

reading: And [[went out of|went out of, came out, went away and marched off, went forth|ἐξέρχομαι]] [[name:Ιακωβ]] [[from|from, away from, far from, apart from|ἀπό]] [[of the well|of the well, of the tank and cistern and reservoir, of the oil jar|φρέαρ]] [[of the object by which one swears|of the object by which one swears and witness of an oath, of the oath|ὅρκος]] and [[was driven|was driven, was carried, went, walked, marched, went across and passed|πορεύομαι]] [[into|into, to, in, rest in|εἰς]] [[name:Χαρραν]].

names.gloss: (Χαρραν, from Hebrew Ḥārān, of uncertain meaning)

greek: καὶ ἀπήντησεν τόπῳ καὶ ἐκοιμήθη ἐκεῖ· ἔδυ γὰρ ὁ ἥλιος· καὶ ἔλαβεν ἀπὸ τῶν λίθων τοῦ τόπου καὶ ἔθηκεν πρὸς κεφαλῆς αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐκοιμήθη ἐν τῷ τόπῳ ἐκείνῳ.
hint: At sunset Jacob stops at a place and sleeps with a stone of the place at his head.

notes.text: ἀπαντάω with the dative, *to meet*.
δύω, whose first sense is *to strip off*; of the sun, *to sink, set*.
πρός with the genitive, *at the head*.
[[flag]] Codex Alexandrinus alone reads ἐπέθηκεν.

[[stripped off|stripped off, entered and made one's way into, went in to, sank and set|δύω]] [[for|for, since and as, for otherwise and else, now, but, why and what, would that|γάρ]] [[the sun|the sun, the day and a day, Helios the sun-god|ἥλιος]]; τόπος]] [[to that|to that, to the one there, to the more remote|ἐκεῖνος]].

greek: καὶ ἐνυπνιάσθη, καὶ ἰδοὺ κλίμαξ ἐστηριγμένη ἐν τῇ γῇ, ἧς ἡ κεφαλὴ ἀφικνεῖτο εἰς τὸν οὐρανόν, καὶ οἱ ἄγγελοι τοῦ θεοῦ ἀνέβαινον καὶ κατέβαινον ἐπʼ αὐτῆς.
hint: Jacob dreams of a ladder set on the earth, its top reaching heaven, God's angels going up and down on it.

notes.text: στηρίζω in the perfect passive, the standing state, as at 27:37.
No Middle Liddell entry; LSJ's ἐνυπνιάζω is *dream*, and MorphGNT files the middle.

reading: and dreamed, and [[lo|lo, behold, see there|ἰδού]] [[ladder|ladder, stairs, scaling-ladder|κλίμαξ]] [[having been made fast|having been made fast and standing so, having been propped, having been fixed, having been set, having been confirmed and established|στηρίζω]] [[in the earth|within, inside of, and by means of the earth, the land, the ground|ἐν; γῆ]], of which [[the head|the head, the life, the top, the brim, the coping, the source, the crown and completion|κεφαλή]] [[was coming to|was coming to, was arriving at and reaching, was arriving|ἀφικνέομαι]] [[into|into, to, in, rest in|εἰς]] [[the heaven|the heaven, the vault, the firmament and the sky|οὐρανός]] , and [[the messengers|the messengers and envoys, the ones that announce, the divine messengers and the angels|ἄγγελος]] [[of the God|of him who is God definitively, of the one the article marks out, of the known and the only|θεός]] [[were going up|were going up, were mounting, were ascending, were going up to, were rising, were coming up, were coming to and arriving at, were going up country, were going aboard|ἀναβαίνω]] and [[were stepping down|were stepping down, were going and coming down, were going down from, were dismounting, were coming down stairs, were going down from the inland parts to the sea, were coming to land and getting safe ashore, were going down into the arena, were coming down from the tribune, were coming to, were ending|καταβαίνω]] [[upon|upon, on, in, at, near|ἐπί + genitive]] her.

greek: ὁ δὲ κύριος ἐπεστήρικτο ἐπʼ αὐτῆς καὶ εἶπεν Ἐγὼ κύριος ὁ θεὸς Αβρααμ τοῦ πατρός σου καὶ ὁ θεὸς Ισαακ· μὴ φοβοῦ· ἡ γῆ, ἐφʼ ἧς σὺ καθεύδεις ἐπʼ αὐτῆς, σοὶ δώσω αὐτὴν καὶ τῷ σπέρματί σου.
hint: The Lord, leaning on the ladder, names himself God of Abraham and Isaac and promises Jacob the land he lies on.

notes.text: ἐπιστηρίζω in the pluperfect, the standing state in the past.
[[flag]] Codex Alexandrinus leaves out the second κύριος; the Berlin papyrus, 911, has it.
Capitalised because it opens direct speech, as Rahlfs prints it; listed in `speech` so the checks do not take it for a proper name.

reading: [[but|but, however, whereas, on the other hand|δέ]], [[the lord|the lord, the master, the one having power and authority over|κύριος]] [[had been made to lean on|had been made to lean on and stood so, had leaned upon|ἐπιστηρίζω]] [[upon|upon, on, in, at, near|ἐπί + genitive]] her and [[said|said, spoke, declared, called by name, told|λέγω]] I [[lord|lord, master, the one having power and authority over|κύριος]] [[the God|him who is God definitively, the one the article marks out, the known and the only|θεός]] of [[name:Αβρααμ]] [[of the father|of the father, of the grandfather|πατήρ]] of you and [[the God|him who is God definitively, the one the article marks out, the known and the only|θεός]] of [[name:Ισαακ]]; [[not|not, that not, perhaps, surely not and you don't mean to say that|μή]] [[be put to flight|be put to flight, flee affrighted, flee, be seized with fear, be affrighted, fear|φοβέομαι]]; [[the earth|the earth, the land, the ground|γῆ]], [[upon|upon, on, in, at, near|ἐπί + genitive]] of which you [[you lie down to sleep|you lie down to sleep and sleep, you lie asleep and lie idle, you sleep and lie still and are at rest|καθεύδω]] [[upon|upon, on, in, at, near|ἐπί + genitive]] her, to you [[I will give|I will give, I will grant, I will provide, I will give over and deliver up|δίδωμι]] her and [[to the that which is sown|to the that which is sown, to the seed, to the germ and origin and element, to the offspring and issue, to the race and descent|σπέρμα]] of you.

greek: καὶ ἔσται τὸ σπέρμα σου ὡς ἡ ἄμμος τῆς γῆς καὶ πλατυνθήσεται ἐπὶ θάλασσαν καὶ ἐπὶ λίβα καὶ ἐπὶ βορρᾶν καὶ ἐπʼ ἀνατολάς, καὶ ἐνευλογηθήσονται ἐν σοὶ πᾶσαι αἱ φυλαὶ τῆς γῆς καὶ ἐν τῷ σπέρματί σου.
hint: Offspring like the sand, spreading every way, and all the tribes of the earth blessed in Jacob.

notes.text: The Hebrew is *kaʿăpar hāʾāreṣ*, *as the dust of the earth*. The Greek has ἄμμος, *sand*.
φυλή, the chain of GEN 10:18: the tribes, where 22:18 has τὰ ἔθνη.

greek: καὶ ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ μετὰ σοῦ διαφυλάσσων σε ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ πάσῃ, οὗ ἐὰν πορευθῇς, καὶ ἀποστρέψω σε εἰς τὴν γῆν ταύτην, ὅτι οὐ μή σε ἐγκαταλίπω ἕως τοῦ ποιῆσαί με πάντα, ὅσα ἐλάλησά σοι.
hint: The Lord promises to guard Jacob on every road, bring him back, and not forsake him until all is done.

notes.text: *Wherever you go*, ἐάν after the relative adverb.
The double negative with the aorist subjunctive, as at 24:33.

reading: and [[lo|lo, behold, see there|ἰδού]] I [[in the midst of|in the midst of, among, in common, along with, with, by means of|μετά + genitive]] you [[watching closely|watching closely and guarding carefully, observing closely, observing and maintaining, guarding against|διαφυλάσσω]] you [[in the way|within, inside of, and by means of the way, the path, the track, the road, the highway, the course, the journey, the manner and method|ἐν; ὁδός]] [[to all|to all, to the whole, to every, to every single|πᾶς]], where ever [[you may be driven|you may be driven, you may be carried, you may go, you may walk, you may march, you may go across and pass|πορεύομαι]], and [[I will turn|I will turn, I will turn back, I will turn away, I will turn myself about, I will bring back|ἀποστρέφω]] you [[into|into, to, in, rest in|εἰς]] [[the earth|the earth, the land, the ground|γῆ]] [[this|this, the nearer, what follows|οὗτος]], [[that|that, seeing that, although, for that, because, inasmuch as|ὅτι]] not [[not|not, that not, perhaps, surely not and you don't mean to say that|μή]] you [[I may leave behind|I may leave behind, I may leave in the lurch, I may leave out and omit|ἐγκαταλείπω]] [[until|until, till, while and so long as|ἕως]] [[of the making|of the making, of the doing, of the producing, of the creating|ποιέω]] me [[all|all, the whole, every, every single|πᾶς]], [[as great as|as great as, as much as, as far as, as long as, as many as|ὅσος]] [[I talked|I talked, I chatted, I prattled, I babbled, I said, I talked of, I spoke, I chattered, I chirped|λαλέω]] to you.

greek: καὶ ἐξηγέρθη Ιακωβ ἀπὸ τοῦ ὕπνου αὐτοῦ καὶ εἶπεν ὅτι Ἔστιν κύριος ἐν τῷ τόπῳ τούτῳ, ἐγὼ δὲ οὐκ ᾔδειν.
hint: Jacob wakes and says the Lord is in this place, though he did not know it.

notes.text: The pluperfect of οἶδα, the chain of GEN 3:5.
Capitalised because it opens direct speech, as Rahlfs prints it; listed in `speech` so the checks do not take it for a proper name.

reading: and [[was awakened|was awakened, was awaked and woke up, was raised from the dead, was aroused and brought on|ἐξεγείρω]] [[name:Ιακωβ]] [[from|from, away from, far from, apart from|ἀπό]] [[of the sleep|of the sleep, of the slumber, of the sleep of death, of the Sleep|ὕπνος]] of him and [[said|said, spoke, declared, called by name, told|λέγω]] [[that|that, seeing that, although, for that, because, inasmuch as|ὅτι]] is [[lord|lord, master, the one having power and authority over|κύριος]] [[in the place|within, inside of, and by means of the place, the local circumstances, the position, the passage in a book, the topic, the common-place, the occasion and opportunity|ἐν; τόπος]] [[to this|to this, to the nearer, to what follows|οὗτος]], I [[but|but, however, whereas, on the other hand|δέ]], not [[I knew|I knew, I was assured, I was versed in|οἶδα]].

greek: καὶ ἐφοβήθη καὶ εἶπεν Ὡς φοβερὸς ὁ τόπος οὗτος· οὐκ ἔστιν τοῦτο ἀλλʼ ἢ οἶκος θεοῦ, καὶ αὕτη ἡ πύλη τοῦ οὐρανοῦ.
hint: Afraid, Jacob calls the place fearful, the house of God and the gate of heaven.

notes.text: ὡς in exclamation, *how*: the adverb, not the comparative conjunction.
θεός without the article, the chain of GEN 1:2.
Capitalised because it opens direct speech, as Rahlfs prints it; listed in `speech` so the checks do not take it for a proper name.

reading: and [[was put to flight|was put to flight, fled affrighted, fled, was seized with fear, was affrighted, feared|φοβέομαι]] and [[said|said, spoke, declared, called by name, told|λέγω]] [[as|as, according as, considering, like|ὡς]] [[fearful|fearful, causing fear and dreadful and terrible, matter for fear and regarded with fear|φοβερός]] [[the place|the place, the local circumstances, the position, the passage in a book, the topic, the common-place, the occasion and opportunity|τόπος]] [[this|this, the nearer, what follows|οὗτος]]; not is [[this|this, the nearer, what follows|οὗτος]] [[otherwise|otherwise, but, except, yet, but then and however, but really and certainly|ἀλλά]] [[or|or, either or, whether or, than and as, rather|ἤ]] [[house|house and abode and dwelling, room and chamber, house of a god and temple, household goods and substance, household and family|οἶκος]] [[of God|of everything that God is by nature, of deity in full and undiminished kind|θεός]], and [[this|this, the nearer, what follows|οὗτος]] [[the one wing of a pair of double gates|the one wing of a pair of double gates, the gates of a town, the house-door, the nether world and hell, the entrance, the orifice, the entrance into a country through mountains and the mountain-pass, the narrow straits|πύλη]] [[of the heaven|of the heaven, of the vault, of the firmament and the sky|οὐρανός]].

greek: καὶ ἀνέστη Ιακωβ τὸ πρωὶ καὶ ἔλαβεν τὸν λίθον, ὃν ὑπέθηκεν ἐκεῖ πρὸς κεφαλῆς αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἔστησεν αὐτὸν στήλην καὶ ἐπέχεεν ἔλαιον ἐπὶ τὸ ἄκρον αὐτῆς.
hint: In the morning Jacob sets up the stone from under his head as a pillar and pours oil on its top.

notes.text: στήλη is first *a block of stone*, then *a prop*, *a slab*, *a gravestone*.
[[flag]] Codex Alexandrinus reads ἔθηκεν; the Berlin papyrus, 911, has ὑπέθηκεν.

reading: and [[stood up|stood up, rose, rose to fight against, rose to go and set out|ἀνίστημι]] [[name:Ιακωβ]] the thing [[early in the day|early in the day, early, at morn, betimes, in good time, too soon and too early|πρωΐ]] and [[took|took, received, took hold of and grasped and seized|λαμβάνω]] [[the stone|the stone, the precious stone, the marble|λίθος]], which [[placed under|placed under, placed under one's feet, placed under as a foundation, suggested and advised, set before, pledged and mortgaged|ὑποτίθημι]] [[there|there, in that place|ἐκεῖ]] [[from|from, from forth, on the side and quarter of, before and in presence of and in the eyes of, before and by, from and on the side of, proceeding from, from and at the hand of, by means and agency of, dependent on, under the protection of, at the beck of, on the side of and in favour of, fitting and suitable, befitting, like, agreeable to|πρός + genitive]] [[of head|of head, of the life, of the top, of the brim, of the coping, of the source, of the crown and completion|κεφαλή]] of him, and [[made to stand|made to stand, set, stopped and stayed and checked, set up and raised, established and instituted, appointed, weighed|ἵστημι]] him [[block of stone|block of stone, prop and buttress to a wall, slab, gravestone, record and contract and agreement, turning-post|στήλη]] and [[poured water over|poured water over, poured|ἐπιχέω]] olive-oil [[upon|upon, on, in, at, near|ἐπί + accusative]] [[the mountain-top|the mountain-top and peak, the headland and foreland and cape, the end and extremity, the highest pitch and height, the exceedingly, the highest place, the prize, the oldest rulers|ἄκρον]] of her.

greek: καὶ ἐκάλεσεν Ιακωβ τὸ ὄνομα τοῦ τόπου ἐκείνου Οἶκος θεοῦ· καὶ Ουλαμλους ἦν ὄνομα τῇ πόλει τὸ πρότερον.
hint: Jacob names the place House of God; the city was once called Ulamlous.

notes.text: The Greek of the Hebrew Bêt-ʾĒl, Bethel, printed as the name, with Rahlfs's capital.
[[flag]] Rahlfs prints Ουλαμλους; Codex Alexandrinus reads ουλαμμαυς.

reading: and [[called|called, summoned, called to himself, invited|καλέω]] [[name:Ιακωβ]] [[the name|the name, the fame, the mere name, the phrase and expression|ὄνομα]] [[of the place|of the place, of the local circumstances, of the position, of the passage in a book, of the topic, of the common-place, of the occasion and opportunity|τόπος]] [[of that|of that, of the one there, of the more remote|ἐκεῖνος]] [[name:Οἶκος]] [[of God|of everything that God is by nature, of deity in full and undiminished kind|θεός]]; and [[name:Ουλαμλους]] was, and kept on being as a standing and continuing condition and not a momentary one, [[a name|a name, fame, a mere name, a phrase and expression|ὄνομα]] [[to the city|to the city, to the citadel, to the country, to the body of citizens, to the state|πόλις]] [[the before|the before and in front and forward, the former and sooner, the elder, the above and superior, the earlier|πρότερος]].

names.gloss: (Οἶκος θεοῦ, "house of God", the Greek of Hebrew Bêt-ʾĒl, Bethel)
(Ουλαμλους, for Hebrew Lûz, Luz, with ʾûlām, "but", read into the name)

greek: καὶ ηὔξατο Ιακωβ εὐχὴν λέγων Ἐὰν ᾖ κύριος ὁ θεὸς μετʼ ἐμοῦ καὶ διαφυλάξῃ με ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ ταύτῃ, ᾗ ἐγὼ πορεύομαι, καὶ δῷ μοι ἄρτον φαγεῖν καὶ ἱμάτιον περιβαλέσθαι
hint: Jacob's vow begins: if the Lord God is with him, guards him on the way, and gives him bread and clothing.

notes.text: The cognate accusative: εὔχομαι with εὐχή.
Capitalised because it opens direct speech, as Rahlfs prints it; listed in `speech` so the checks do not take it for a proper name.

reading: and [[prayed|prayed, offered prayers, paid his vows, made a vow, prayed for|εὔχομαι]] [[name:Ιακωβ]] [[prayer|prayer, vow, a mere wish and an aspiration, a prayer for evil, an imprecation|εὐχή]] [[saying|saying, speaking, declaring, calling by name, telling|λέγω]] [[if haply|if haply, if|ἐάν]] may be [[lord|lord, master, the one having power and authority over|κύριος]] [[the God|him who is God definitively, the one the article marks out, the known and the only|θεός]] [[in the midst of|in the midst of, among, in common, along with, with, by means of|μετά + genitive]] me and [[may watch closely|may watch closely and guard carefully, may observe closely, may observe and maintain, may guard against|διαφυλάσσω]] me [[in the way|within, inside of, and by means of the way, the path, the track, the road, the highway, the course, the journey, the manner and method|ἐν; ὁδός]] [[to this|to this, to the nearer, to what follows|οὗτος]], to which I [[I am driven|I am driven, I am carried, I go, I walk, I march, I go across and pass|πορεύομαι]], and [[may give|may give, may grant, may provide, may give over and deliver up|δίδωμι]] to me [[cake|cake, loaf of wheat-bread, bread|ἄρτος]] [[to eat|to eat, to eat of|ἐσθίω]] and [[outer garment|outer garment, cloak and mantle, Roman toga, clothes, cloth|ἱμάτιον]] [[to throw round oneself|to throw round oneself, to put on, to throw round oneself for defence, to build round, to surround and enclose for oneself, to bring into one's power and aim at, to cloke and veil|περιβάλλω]]

greek: καὶ ἀποστρέψῃ με μετὰ σωτηρίας εἰς τὸν οἶκον τοῦ πατρός μου, καὶ ἔσται μοι κύριος εἰς θεόν,
hint: The vow goes on: if he returns safe to his father's house, the Lord will be his God.

notes.text: θεός without the article, the qualitative chain of GEN 17:7.

reading: and [[may turn|may turn, may turn back, may turn away, may turn himself about, may bring back|ἀποστρέφω]] me [[in the midst of|in the midst of, among, in common, along with, with, by means of|μετά + genitive]] [[of a saving|of a saving and deliverance and preservation and safety, of a safe return, of a keeping safe, of security and a guarantee for safety|σωτηρία]] [[into|into, to, in, rest in|εἰς]] [[the house|the house and abode and dwelling, the room and chamber, the house of a god and temple, the household goods and substance, the household and family|οἶκος]] [[of the father|of the father, of the grandfather|πατήρ]] of me, and will be to me [[lord|lord, master, the one having power and authority over|κύριος]] [[into|into, to, in, rest in|εἰς]] [[God|everything that God is by nature, deity in full and undiminished kind|θεός]],

greek: καὶ ὁ λίθος οὗτος, ὃν ἔστησα στήλην, ἔσται μοι οἶκος θεοῦ, καὶ πάντων, ὧν ἐάν μοι δῷς, δεκάτην ἀποδεκατώσω αὐτά σοι.
hint: The vow ends: the pillar stone will be a house of God, and Jacob will tithe all he is given.

notes.text: The cognate accusative again: δεκάτη with ἀποδεκατόω, as at 14:20.

reading: and [[the stone|the stone, the precious stone, the marble|λίθος]] [[this|this, the nearer, what follows|οὗτος]], which [[I made to stand|I made to stand, I set, I stopped and stayed and checked, I set up and raised, I established and instituted, I appointed, I weighed|ἵστημι]] [[block of stone|block of stone, prop and buttress to a wall, slab, gravestone, record and contract and agreement, turning-post|στήλη]], will be to me [[house|house and abode and dwelling, room and chamber, house of a god and temple, household goods and substance, household and family|οἶκος]] [[of God|of everything that God is by nature, of deity in full and undiminished kind|θεός]], and [[of all|of all, of the whole, of every, of every single|πᾶς]], of which ever to me [[you may give|you may give, you may grant, you may provide, you may give over and deliver up|δίδωμι]], [[a tenth|a tenth, a tenth part and tithe, a tenth day|δεκάτη]] [[I will tithe|I will tithe and pay tithes of, I will take tithe|ἀποδεκατόω]] them to you.
